Container.Name: Gods-Eye-View
Container.Overview: God's Eye View is a browser-based 3D globe for exploring public aircraft, ship, satellite, earthquake, traffic, camera, radio, fire, and other geospatial data. This image packages the upstream v0.3.0 application and its required Vite proxy server. It starts without API keys. Optional provider credentials unlock additional data and voice features. Intended for a trusted home LAN; the application has no user authentication.
Container.Requires: WebGL-capable browser. Keep this container on a trusted LAN or behind a separately reviewed authenticated reverse proxy. Anyone who can reach the web interface can use configured provider-backed endpoints and consume their quotas. Provider Settings inside the app is intentionally unavailable for a network-shared container; configure optional keys in this template. Restrict client-visible Google Maps, Cesium, and Mapillary credentials at their providers. Use a separate server-side Google key for Places and geocoding, and set provider-side quotas or spending limits.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: God's Eye View web interface. Keep it restricted to a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: Allowed Hostnames
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated LAN hostnames, such as globe.lan or unraid.local. IP addresses and localhost already work. Wildcards are not accepted.

Config.Name: Cesium ion Token
Config.Description: Optional client-visible assets:read token for photorealistic 3D and world terrain. Apply URL restrictions and provider quotas.

Config.Name: Google Maps API Key
Config.Description: Optional client-visible key for Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles and browser Street View. Apply HTTP-referrer and API restrictions for Map Tiles and Maps JavaScript, plus provider quotas. Use the separate server key for Places and geocoding.

Config.Name: Google Maps Server API Key
Config.Description: Optional server-side key for Google Places, geocoding, and Street View Static. Apply server-IP and API restrictions plus provider quotas. Without it upstream falls back to the browser key, whose referrer restrictions may reject server requests.

Config.Name: Mapillary Client Token
Config.Description: Optional client-visible token for Mapillary Street Level imagery. This token is delivered to browsers; apply available provider restrictions. Panoramax and KartaView do not require it.

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Optional server-side key for Gemini Live voice. Configure provider-side restrictions, quotas, and spending limits before use. Browser microphone requirements still apply.

Config.Name: Gemini Requests per Minute per Client
Config.Description: Process-local per-client limit for Gemini session-token requests. This is not a billing cap.

Config.Name: Ontario 511 API Key
Config.Description: Optional server-side key for Ontario 511 cameras. Obtain your own operator key and accept its terms; this pack is skipped without a key.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Optional server-side key for realtime voice and AI HUD summaries. Configure provider-side spending limits before use.

Config.Name: OpenAI Requests per Minute per Client
Config.Description: Process-local per-client limit for OpenAI-backed endpoints. This is not a billing cap.

Config.Name: Google Requests per Minute per Client
Config.Description: Process-local per-client limit shared by Google Places and geocoding requests. This is not a billing cap.

Config.Name: AISStream API Key
Config.Description: Optional server-side key for live vessel positions.

Config.Name: NASA FIRMS Map Key
Config.Description: Optional server-side key for live active-fire detections.

Config.Name: TomTom API Key
Config.Description: Optional server-side key for live traffic-flow speeds. Keyless traffic remains simulated.

Config.Name: TomTom Daily Tile Budget
Config.Description: Application-level UTC-day limit for TomTom upstream tile requests. Retains the existing template default of 40000; upstream defaults to 6000. Container recreation resets the local budget. This is not a provider billing cap.

Config.Name: OpenSky Authentication Mode
Config.Description: Use anon without credentials. Set oauth when configuring both OpenSky client fields.

Config.Name: OpenSky Client ID
Config.Description: Optional OAuth client ID for additional OpenSky polling credits. Also set mode to oauth and provide the client secret.

Config.Name: OpenSky Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional OAuth client secret for OpenSky. Also set mode to oauth and provide the client ID.

Config.Name: Launch Library 2 Token
Config.Description: Optional server-side token for a higher space-missions request allowance.
